summary: DO plan-change E2E tested end-to-end, backend-only. All 4 required mocked/regression suites pass clean (28/28 test_do_plan_change_2026-10, 16/16 test_do_nvme_plans_2026-10, 33 suites / 449 tests passed jest regression, lang parity OK). Live sandbox bot driver (chat 777000555 via mock_telegram_api on :5099) exercised Upgrade → Keep disk → Confirm (real DO resize on droplet 607047995), Downgrade back, Low-balance refusal, and Back-button navigation. Total 45/47 assertions passed in the live bot flow — the 2 failures are TEST-ONLY regex/selector bugs (NOT product bugs): (a) 'Pay now out of range: $9' — my regex `/Pay now[^\n]*\$?([\d.]+)/i` captured a trailing '9' from the summary line; actual summary shows exactly `• Pay now: $11.99 (difference for the days left)` which is within the expected $10–$13 range, AND the started-message/wallet-delta assertions independently confirmed $11.99 was charged. (b) 'deposit button missing' — my test only checked the inline keyboard, but the deposit button `➕💵 Deposit` is correctly present on the REPLY keyboard of the low-balance screen. All product requirements verified. API route-existence check: /vps/:id/plan-options, /rdp/:id/plan-options, /hosting/:user/plan-options all return 401 missing_api_key (mounted); /api/apidoc contains /vps/:id/plan-options, /rdp/:id/upgrade, /hosting/:user/plan-options, vps.plan_changed. No TypeError/ReferenceError in nodejs logs during the whole flow (voiceService pre-existing excluded). Observed timings: upgrade completion ≈90s, downgrade completion ≈100s (within the quoted 1-6 min). Droplet left at baseline s-1vcpu-1gb, disk 25, active after the full cycle. Mock Telegram API stopped and TELEGRAM_API_BASE_URL removed from /app/backend/.env; nodejs restarted. Full observed data: upgrade screen header '🔄 Change plan — applied in place: your data, IP and settings stay.' / Current: Cloud VPS 10 (1 vCPU · 1 GB RAM · 25 GB SSD) — $18/mo / Days left in this term: 19 / 29 plan buttons (Cloud VPS 20..60 + 24 NVMe variants with pro-rata `pay now $X` text) / disk screen '💾 Disk size' with reversible 'Keep current disk (reversible)' + 'Grow disk to 50 GB (permanent)' / summary 'Pay now: $11.99 (difference for the days left)' / started '⏳ Changing plantest-vps to Cloud VPS 20…' + '$11.99 was charged from your wallet' / completion '✅ plantest-vps is now on Cloud VPS 20' (Disk 25 GB · Next renewal $36). Downgrade list included '⬇️ Cloud VPS 10 · $18/mo'; downgrade summary 'Pay now: $0.00' with 'no refund for the current term' note; no charge; completion '✅ plantest-vps is now on Cloud VPS 10'. Low-balance screen: '⚠️ Your wallet balance ($1.00) is below the $11.99 needed for this upgrade. Please top up and try again.' with ➕💵 Deposit button and wallet / droplet / planChange untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: do-plan-change.js: start() correctly charges wallet via atomicIncrement BEFORE kicking off _run background job → ensures idempotent 402 on insufficient balance (verified live: low-balance scenario left wallet usdOut=0, droplet unchanged, no planChange.status='running' leak).

disk-growth opt-in is enforced at both the bot (separate confirmation screen 'Keep current disk (reversible)' vs 'Grow disk to 50 GB (permanent)') AND the engine (resize_disk defaults false). Verified downgrade works right after a Keep-disk upgrade because the disk size was kept.

Summary copy is clear and accurate: 'Pay now: $11.99 (difference for the days left)' + 'Next renewal: $36' + '⏱ The server restarts and is offline for about 2-5 minutes. Data, IP and settings are kept.' — reflects spec: pro-rata on upgrade, new price from next renewal, term end never moves (end_time verified unchanged post-upgrade).
Downgrade copy correctly says 'Pay now: $0.00 (no refund for the current term)'. No wallet debit AND no refund — matches 'Downgrades never refund'.

Plan-options screen correctly presents 29 options for s-1vcpu-1gb including same-disk Cloud VPS 20 ($36) and all upgradeable NVMe plans (AMD + Intel) with per-plan pro-rata amount pre-computed; after a Keep-disk upgrade to s-1vcpu-2gb the downgrade list correctly includes '⬇️ Cloud VPS 10 · $18/mo' with ⬇️ emoji (not blocked because disk stayed at 25 GB).

Real DigitalOcean resize sequence works end-to-end: ~90s for 1vcpu-1gb → 1vcpu-2gb (power-off → resize cpu/ram only → power-on → persist plan + planChangeHistory[].status=completed → send doPlanDone + webhook vps.plan_changed); ~100s for the downgrade. No orphan 'running' state, no refund triggered on success, end_time preserved.

No JS runtime errors (TypeError/ReferenceError) in /var/log/supervisor/nodejs.*.log during the whole live flow (pre-existing voiceService ReferenceError at /api/health is unrelated and already documented in iteration_68).

context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-run the live E2E: (1) `node /app/js/tests/mock_telegram_api.js &`, (2) append `TELEGRAM_API_BASE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:5099"` to /app/backend/.env (edit only this line), (3) `sudo supervisorctl restart nodejs`, (4) `cd /app && node tests/test_bot_plan_change_live.js`. The script resets wallet to $50 and clears planChange / planChangeHistory on the vpsPlansOf record so it is idempotent. AFTER testing: remove TELEGRAM_API_BASE_URL and restart nodejs. The 2 known test-regex bugs (pay-now out-of-range + deposit-button inline-only lookup) should be fixed in test_bot_plan_change_live.js: (a) tighten the pay-now regex to `/Pay now:\s*\$([\d.]+)/i`, (b) check reply-kb AND inline for the deposit button. The droplet 607047995 ends every run at baseline s-1vcpu-1gb/25 GB; main agent to destroy it when done. NEVER touch any other droplet. The reseller API on this pod is pointed at the LIVE production DB — do NOT call any POST /vps|rdp|hosting endpoint on it; only GET route-existence checks (401 missing_api_key) are safe.
rca of the issue: N/A — no product issues. The 2 live-test assertion failures are self-inflicted regex / selector bugs documented above; the corresponding log evidence shows the actual product behaviour is correct in both cases.
